turns.message: I ordered WeCool earbuds from VLE Bazaar, an online marketplace, on April 14, 2025 and paid ₹359. When the package was delivered on April 30, 2025 it contained boAt earbuds instead. I contacted the platform immediately and they asked me to email photographs of the wrong product. I sent them and followed up repeatedly, but got no response, and the wrong product was never taken back.
